name: Bluetooth LE scanner
description: A Bluetooth LE scanner, as a phone's scanner app sees the devices around it: it listens on the advertising channels and lists each advertiser it hears, its address, PDU type, name and RSSI. It reaches the circuit only through the air.

window.doc: How long it listens in each scan interval

interval.doc: The scan interval: it listens on the next advertising channel (37, 38, 39) each interval

active.doc: Active scanning, as phones scan: a SCAN_REQ after each scannable PDU (with the specification's backoff) for the advertiser's scan response

address.doc: The phone's random static address, its SCAN_REQs' ScanA

outputs.name: pdus
outputs.doc: Advertising PDUs and scan responses heard

outputs.name: list
outputs.doc: Each advertiser: its address (public or random), last PDU type, RSSI, whether it is connectable, its name and, for an iBeacon, its UUID, major, minor and measured power

functional.claims: Passive scanning on the primary advertising channels at 1M: ADV_IND, ADV_DIRECT_IND, ADV_NONCONN_IND and ADV_SCAN_IND heard on the channel its window is open on, the scan window and interval as set (Bluetooth Core 5.4 Vol 6 Part B 2.3, 4.4.3); active scanning: a SCAN_REQ T_IFS after ADV_IND and ADV_SCAN_IND from its random static address, the backoff procedure (4.4.3.2), the SCAN_RSP taken; each advertiser's address and kind, its local name from the AD structures, an iBeacon's proximity UUID, major, minor and measured power (Apple's manufacturer data), the RSSI the free-space path loss over the bench distance gives (engine/air.h).
omissions: extended advertising on the secondary channels

electrical.claims: As functional: it has no pins.

sources.title: Bluetooth Core Specification 5.4, Vol 6 Part B: the Link Layer (advertising PDUs, scanning)
sources.notes: The advertising channel PDUs and their headers, the AD structures' local names, the scan window and interval.

fr.description: Un scanner Bluetooth LE, tel que l'application de scan d'un téléphone voit les appareils autour d'elle : il écoute les canaux d'annonce et liste chaque annonceur qu'il entend, son adresse, son type de PDU, son nom et son RSSI. Il n'atteint le circuit que par l'air.

functional.claims: Balayage passif sur les canaux d'annonce primaires en 1M : ADV_IND, ADV_DIRECT_IND, ADV_NONCONN_IND et ADV_SCAN_IND entendus sur le canal où sa fenêtre est ouverte, la fenêtre et l'intervalle de balayage tels que réglés (Bluetooth Core 5.4 Vol 6 Part B 2.3, 4.4.3) ; balayage actif : un SCAN_REQ T_IFS après ADV_IND et ADV_SCAN_IND depuis son adresse statique aléatoire, la procédure de recul (4.4.3.2), le SCAN_RSP pris ; l'adresse et le type de chaque annonceur, son nom local tiré des structures AD, l'UUID de proximité, le major, le minor et la puissance mesurée d'un iBeacon (les données fabricant d'Apple), le RSSI que donne l'affaiblissement en espace libre sur la distance du banc (engine/air.h).
omissions: les annonces étendues sur les canaux secondaires

electrical.claims: Comme en fonctionnel : il n'a pas de broches.
